div.div: بَغْشَةٌ A weak shower of rain; (S, K:) above what is called طَشَّة: (S:) or weak rain, small in its drops; as also ↓ بَغْشٌ [originally an inf. n.]: or both signify a cloud that pours forth its rain in one shower: As says that the lightest and weakest of rain is that called طَلّ; then, the رَذَاذ; then, the بَغْش: the dim. of the last is بُغَيْشٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
